summary: UC3: Nice to Have — 10-Second Skip Back/Forward for Video Playback
label: nice-to-have
note: Nice-to-have. PM confirmed IN SCOPE for this release (ledger AMB-04, 2026-07). Retains the nice-to-have flag — could still be descoped if it impacts the delivery timeline.
user_story: As a community member watching a video, I want to skip backward or forward 10 seconds so that I can quickly rewatch or jump ahead without scrubbing.
preconditions: User is viewing a video post or recorded livestream (not a live stream)
entry_points: A. User taps the player surface to reveal the controls overlay
B. Controls overlay is already visible
last_synced: 2026-07-08 (Jira updated 2026-07-07 16:44 — NEW group 'Rapid repeated taps (MVP)': AC-07 accumulate + AC-08 boundary-mid-burst; AC-03/AC-04 now end in a paused state; scope confirmed in-release)

not_supported: Desktop — no behaviour change; only a small UI design change (button size)

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Tap skip back (−10s) → playback jumps back 10s, continues
acceptance_criteria.when: The user taps the skip back button (−10s)
then: Playback jumps back 10 seconds from the current position

clarifications_needed.observation: AC-01/02 skip ±10s per tap but did not specify behaviour when the user taps rapidly (e.g. skip-back 3× quickly)
clarifications_needed.consequence: The final position was unpredictable (−30s or −10s?) → non-deterministic test results
clarifications_needed.question: Should rapid repeated skip taps accumulate (3 taps = ±30s) or be debounced to a single ±10s?
clarifications_needed.resolution: ACCUMULATE — each tap adds ±10s (PM 68330; iOS Prisa 68329). Icon always shows +10/-10 (accumulated total UI is a future enhancement). Now encoded as AC-07/AC-08. NOTE: web current behaviour was debounce-to-single (Chayanit 68304); web must CHANGE to accumulate to meet the AC. See ledger GAP-07.

clarifications_needed.observation: No behaviour was specified for tapping skip while the video is buffering
clarifications_needed.consequence: May stick on loading or land at the wrong position
clarifications_needed.question: Should skip while buffering queue until the buffer is ready, or seek-and-rebuffer at the target position?
clarifications_needed.resolution: Mobile: seek-and-rebuffer at the target position (Prisa 68329) — clear. Web: shows a 'Reconnecting' UI while loading and lets the user scrub to renew position (Chayanit 68304) — does not crisply state what the +10/-10 button does mid-buffer. Low severity, non-blocking. Web skip-during-buffer behaviour to confirm — FOLLOWUPS FU-3. See ledger GAP-08.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Tap skip forward (+10s) → playback jumps forward 10s, continues
acceptance_criteria.when: The user taps the skip forward button (+10s)
then: Playback jumps forward 10 seconds from the current position

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Rapid repeated skip taps → each tap adds ±10s (accumulate); icon still shows ±10
acceptance_criteria.when: The user taps a skip button multiple times quickly
then: Each tap adds 10 seconds to the total (e.g. video at 1:00, tapping skip forward 3 times quickly → moves to 1:30)
The skip icon does not update to reflect the accumulated total — it always shows +10 or -10

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Rapid skip taps near start/end → each tap still obeys the boundary rules mid-burst
given: The user taps a skip button multiple times quickly near the start or end of the video
acceptance_criteria.when: A tap would move playback past 0:00 or past the final frame
then: That tap follows the boundary rules (AC-03 / AC-04) — it does not go to a negative position or loop, even mid-burst

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Skip back at <10s from start → jumps to 0:00, ends in paused state
given: The current position is less than 10 seconds into the video
then: Playback jumps to 0:00 — it does not go to a negative position
The prior playback state is preserved — if the video was playing it continues from 0:00; if it was paused it stays paused (a boundary skip-back does NOT force a pause)

clarifications_needed.observation: AC-03 (as updated 2026-07-07) said skip-back to the 0:00 boundary leaves the video PAUSED, whereas normal skip-back (AC-01) continues playback
clarifications_needed.consequence: Asymmetry: hitting the start boundary paused, but a normal skip did not
clarifications_needed.question: Is pausing at 0:00 after a boundary skip-back intended, or should playback continue like AC-01?
clarifications_needed.resolution: Decision 2026-07-08: PRESERVE prior state at the 0:00 boundary — playing→continue from 0:00, paused→stay paused (no forced pause). Consistent with AC-01 (playing skip continues) and AC-05 (paused skip stays paused). AC-03 then[1] corrected. AC-04 (final-frame) keeps the end/paused state because reaching the end naturally stops playback — the asymmetry is now intentional. Jira AC-03 still says 'paused state' → PM to align Jira (FU-5). See ledger AMB-11.

clarifications_needed.observation: AC-03 covers 'less than 10 seconds' and AC-04 'within 10 seconds' — the exact-10-seconds value was not stated
clarifications_needed.consequence: Off-by-one: at exactly 10s from start/end, should skip clamp or skip normally?
clarifications_needed.question: When the position is exactly 10 seconds from the start/end, clamp (0:00 / final frame) or skip normally?
clarifications_needed.resolution: At exactly 10s from start → skip-back goes to 0:00; at exactly 10s from end → skip-forward goes to the final frame (ledger AMB-08). (Both coincide with a normal ±10s skip, so the boundary and normal paths agree at the exact-10 value.)

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Skip forward at <10s from end → jumps to final frame, ends in paused state
given: The current position is within 10 seconds of the video end
then: Playback jumps to the final frame and enters the end state (paused at the final frame — there is no content past the end to continue into)
It does not loop or error

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Skip while paused → position updates, video stays paused
acceptance_criteria.when: The user taps either skip button
then: The video remains paused — skip does not auto-resume playback

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Live stream + controls visible → skip buttons not shown
then: The skip back and skip forward buttons are not shown — seeking is not applicable on a live stream

clarifications_needed.observation: AC-06 hides in-app skip buttons on live. But Android can fast-forward/rewind a live stream via the OS-native media control (iOS/web cannot) — platform table 68264
clarifications_needed.consequence: Without a scope statement, someone may think seeking on live is fully blocked, or may treat the native-control seek as acceptable
clarifications_needed.question: Does AC-06 cover only the in-app overlay buttons? Is native OS media-control scrubbing on live (Android) acceptable?
clarifications_needed.resolution: AC-06 covers ONLY the in-app overlay buttons. Native OS media-control scrubbing on a live stream (Android) is NOT acceptable — it is a bug to be filed separately (ledger AMB-05, FOLLOWUPS FU-4).
